evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2010 (16 years old), right here: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).

Cross River 80 m NW: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-25, Region 4 Kootenay.
Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle for Hunting Closed Area: Cross River. Closed April 1 to June 30 and September 1 to February 28 (February 29 in a leap year). Synopsis map 2-16/23.

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-25: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%). From MU 4-25 you have 24 hours to take the animal to the Invermere or Canal Flats freezer through MU 4-26 (page 15, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 4-25, Region 4 Kootenay.
Private land 230 m S: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-25: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%). From MU 4-25 you have 24 hours to take the animal to the Invermere or Canal Flats freezer through MU 4-26 (page 15, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).
